name: Permits & Licensing Committee Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  February 05, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room
“A” 1st Floor on February 5, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Tomeka Holyfield on behalf of Helppping Hands Foundation Inc. to host an All-Star
  Community Care Food Giveaway Event at 333 W. Florence Ave, Private Property,
  on Thursday, February 12, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1-day event within private property. Subject to
  Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event cleanup; Approved; Applicant to hire two (2) IPD officers for
  public safety and four (4) TCO's for intermittent traffic control. Applicant to also hire
  a minimum of four (4) FCC security personnel to assist IPD with any potential crowd
  control. This will be a drive-thru food giveaway event, and traffic is expected to be
  fluid with no issues. Security personnel shall where reflective vests for risk
  management. NOTE: IPD watch commander will be notified, and an extra patrol will
  be requested. None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional conditions for
  Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately
  at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow
  all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426445)
 Item #2:  Julio Garcia on behalf of LA Clippers LLC to host a Basketball Blvd Event at 3800
  W. Century Blvd; Private Property, on Thursday, February 12, 2026, from 6:00 p.m.
  to 9:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within
  private property. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all
  applicable mitigation measures; Police and TCO staffing required for public safety
  and traffic safety. Applicant to hire fourteen (14) professional security guards to
  assist IPD with any potential crowd control; Applicant to hire two (2) Code
  Enforcement Officers assigned for vendor enforcement and noise mitigation, must
  provide a direct point of contact of the person(s) in charge of sound and acoustics
  volume control; Fire is approving with the condition that existing Fire Life Safety
  Systems are inspected and verified to be in service; A site inspection is also still
  required ; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at
  the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all
  social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426505)

Item #3:  Areial Lomack on behalf of League Twenty Two to host a Nike x JD Sports Block
  Party Event; at 1209 District Dr. Unit 1100A; Both City & Private Property; from
  Friday, February 13, 2026 from 3:00.pm.-9:00 p.m. and Saturday, February 14,
  2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 2
  day event within Hollywood Park retail district and surrounding streets. Subject to
  Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant is responsible
  for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures.;
  APPROVED: Applicant will need to hire one (1) sergeant, two (2) police officers for
  public safety, and three (3) TCOs for traffic control. The hours for Police staffing are:
  Friday, 02/13/26, from 2 pm-10 pm, and Saturday, 02/14/26, from 10 am-2 pm. The
  hours for TCOs are: Friday 02/13/26 from 1 pm-10 pm and Saturday 02/14/26 from
  9 am-2 pm. Applicant will need to hire a traffic control company to add Meridian
  Barriers to their traffic control plan for the street closures. The applicant shall ensure
  that trained personnel are stationed at the traffic barriers to move them to allow First
  Responder Access in the event of an emergency. Applicant to hire a minimum of
  twenty (20) professional-licensed security guards to assist IPD with any potential
  crowd control. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws; Applicant to hire two city
  Code Enforcement Officers assigned to periodically take noise readings. Applicant
  must provide a direct point of contact of the person(s) in charge of sound and
  acoustics volume control; None additional conditions for Fire approval; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event;
   Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all
  State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00426395)

Item #4:  Derrick Young on behalf of WSS to host a WSS All – Star Community Day Event at
  3000 W. Century Blvd; Private Property, from Saturday, February 14, 2026 from
  12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a one (1) day
  event within WSS parking lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean
  up, and all applicable mitigation measures.; Approved: Applicant to hire two (2) IPD
  officers for public safety and a min. of twelve (12) security guards to assist with any
  potential crowd control; Applicant to hire two (2) security guards;security guards
  should be deployed where guests are parking to attend this event; Conditons:
  Provide noise mitigation plan for this event that complies with the City's Municipal
  Code (85 decibels). Must provide a direct point of contact of the person(s) in charge
  of sound and acoustics volume control.; None additional conditions for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of
  the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set
  forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere
  to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00426408)

2026 - New Business License Request (s):
Item #5:  Albert Melino on behalf of AJ Melino & Associates Inc to operate as a Guard Services
  in Inglewood APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Maintain valid and
  current Private Patrol Operator License from the Department of Consumer Affairs,
  Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Security Guards must be licensed with
  the Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security and Investigative Services;
  Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited from hiring or employing any person
  registered under California Penal Code Section 290 PC or any person that may pose
  a public safety risk/threat to patients or other employees at the location; and Adhere
  to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result
  in the revocation of your business license and any future business license
  application requests. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426443)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
Finance\Committee\P&L Agenda Special Meeting 2.5.26
